name: Open MPI
description: Builds Open MPI 5.0.11 into /opt/wise with UCX (InfiniBand/RoCE, CUDA-aware across nodes with GPUDirect RDMA) and OFI (libfabric) transports; CUDA-aware when the base image provides CUDA_HOME. PMIx is internal, so mpirun works standalone and srun --mpi=pmix works under Slurm. The default MPI of every delivery; an image holds exactly one MPI Feature.
